name: What is the typical process for designing and installing landscape lighting with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for designing and installing landscape lighting with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process for landscape lighting, as part of a larger outdoor living project, begins with an initial consultation to understand your vision and the unique characteristics of your property. We then move into design planning, often using CAD-supported layouts to visualize the lighting scheme's integration with elements like custom patios or outdoor kitchens. Following design approval and permit coordination, our experienced team manages the installation, ensuring seamless execution and functionality, culminating in a final walkthrough to ensure your complete satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, design planning with visualizations, permit coordination, professional installation, and a final walkthrough for your comprehensive outdoor project.
